# Traffic & latency
{: .no_toc }

Trends and SLO tracking.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `OPS-02` |
| **Route** | `/ops/traffic` |
| **Where** | Operations › Traffic & latency |
| **Who can use it** | operations.view |
| **Kind** | detail |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M3 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Range | segmented control | 1h · 24h · 7d · 30d | in the URL |
| Charts | time series | requests, 4xx, 5xx, p95 latency, throttles | accessible table view of each chart (ACCESSIBILITY) |
| SLOs | progress + burn rate | 99.9 % non-5xx; p95 < 150 ms on effective-permissions, app-tokens and oauth/token; p95 < 400 ms elsewhere | per-operation SLOs hidden until [G6 #43](https://github.com/CompositeCode/substratalapps.com/issues/43) gives per-operation data |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry

## For developers

Loads: `GET /ops/metrics?panel=traffic&range={1h|24h|7d|30d}`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
